rationale: The run landed on the homepage (no product tiles) and likely hit cookie/region gating. Directing to a stable PLP under en-gb and handling the OneTrust cookie banner should allow tiles to render. Adding resilient PLP/PDP selectors and URL normalization prevents locale drift and cross-domain hops that break scraping.
code_hints: If current page is homepage (no PLP tiles after 4s), hard-navigate to start_url override.
After navigation, try clicking cookie banner: querySelector('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler')?.click().
Wait for PLP hydration by polling for product tiles count > 0; then scroll/infinite-load using the configured infinite_scroll and/or click load_more_selector if present.
Extract PDP links from product_link within product_tile; de-duplicate and normalize via url_rules before visiting.
On PDP, if CSS price not found, parse JSON-LD: script[type='application/ld+json'] and read offers.price and name as fallback.
If a geolocation/region overlay appears, try clicking a visible button/link containing 'Continue' or 'United Kingdom'; then re-check for PLP tiles.
